artifact: ProofKey Work Treasury allocation schema V1
status: Frozen proposed application ABI and synthetic vectors; no deployed-contract or native-authentication claim.

allocation.name: AllocationV1
allocation.leafEncoding: abi.encode(allocation.typeHash, every AllocationV1 field in fields order); hash with keccak256
allocation.assignment: Per epoch: treeIndex = leafCount before append; allocationId = uint64(treeIndex) + 1. One sequence for every kind, never reset or caller-selected.
constraints: amount > 0; claimOwner and destination are nonzero; kind/role pair must match the fixed table.
policyHash is the epoch-fixed policy-version hash. Order-specific policy configuration belongs in the immutable order/terms commitment identified by orderId.
epochId binds the separately documented immutable source/target configuration. This file does not replace or invent that configuration encoding.
asset equals the funded epoch asset. address(0) denotes native CTC in the target domain.
WORK and FEE use nonzero orderId and the authorized terms/policy amounts, owner and destination.
RETURN has orderId = bytes32(0), milestoneId = 0, role = 0, and epoch refundBeneficiary as both owner and canonical destination.
Economic consumption key is (epochId, allocationId) across every evidence route and root.
Only the source canonical append routine emits AllocationCreated. The event includes every field used in its leaf hash.

allocation.typeString: ProofKeyAllocationV1(bytes32 epochId,uint64 allocationId,uint32 treeIndex,uint8 kind,bytes32 orderId,uint32 milestoneId,uint8 role,address asset,uint256 amount,address claimOwner,address destination,bytes32 policyHash,bytes32 evidenceHash)

outcomeEvidence.typeString: ProofKeyOutcomeEvidenceV1(bytes32 epochId,bytes32 orderId,uint32 milestoneId,bytes32 termsHash,bytes32 deliveryHash,bytes32 decisionHash)

tree.emptySubtree: zero[0] = empty leaf hash; zero[level+1] = node(zero[level], zero[level])
tree.order: Never sort pairs. At proof level i from the leaf, bit i of treeIndex chooses left (0) or right (1).
tree.proof: Exactly seven sibling hashes, ordered from leaf level to root level. Index must be below checkpoint leafCount and the epoch capacity.

events.canonicalRule: Require exact topic count, exact data length and canonical ABI words; no trailing bytes, truncated data or nonzero high padding.
Require exact topic count, exact data length and canonical ABI words; no trailing bytes, truncated data or nonzero high padding.

checkpoint.capConstraint: earned + returned <= cap; CLOSED requires earned + returned = cap and source available = unresolved = 0.
checkpoint.publication: Publish the final stored snapshot for each affected epoch atomically after all allocations/accounting/phase updates in each coordinator call. Checkpoints consume no allocation-tree slots.
checkpoint.republishRule: Accept only an initialized or terminally expired epochId. Emit its current stored root/leafCount/E/R/phase. No caller root, prefix, leaves or counters. No allocation/accounting/state mutation or callback.
checkpoint.oldRoots: Previously authenticated roots remain valid; do not require checkpoint arrival order to be monotonic.

evidenceCommitment.purpose: Typed commitment to immutable outcome or release content. It is not native receipt authentication and is not an additional payment predicate.
evidenceCommitment.outcomeEncoding: keccak256(abi.encode(outcomeEvidence.typeHash, epochId, orderId, milestoneId, termsHash, deliveryHash, decisionHash))
rules: WORK/FEE of the same source outcome may share evidenceHash; their kind/role/amount/recipient remain separately committed in their leaves.

termsHash, deliveryHash and decisionHash commit canonical immutable application content for the source route; an absent delivery uses bytes32(0). Their route-specific payload codecs are separate policy artifacts.
authorizationHash commits pre-existing bound authorization content for an authorized release; permissionless sweep/expiry uses bytes32(0).
Never include the current emitting transaction hash, its current log ordinal, the resulting leaf hash or resulting Merkle root in the evidence preimage. This avoids a self-reference.

nativeProfile.input: Exact encodedTransaction / prover txBytes supplied to the native verifier. The library documents abi.encode(uint8 txType, bytes[] chunks); tx types 0–4 and chunk count/receipt position are determined by the pinned decoder.
nativeProfile.receiptSelection: Decode successful receipt status and use receipt-local log ordinal. RPC block-global logIndex is not interchangeable.
cacheBinding: pinned native profile identity from deployment manifest
nativeProfile.limits: No new native codec number, native profile authorization, receipt proof, runtime behavior or deployment bytecode is asserted here. Deployment manifests must later pin the actual addresses, source/target bytecode and exact dependency/profile identity.

scopeLimits: Synthetic values are not real source events, target deposits, approvals, users, payments or native proofs.

Golden vectors freeze application ABI/hash/proof conventions; they do not verify Solidity, event authorization, Safe, source accounting, canonical native decoding, capacity safety or hybrid equivalence.
The epoch-domain and policy-specific content codecs remain separately specified; no vector here proves a source epoch is funded on Creditcoin.
